value.signature: fn content_matches_supplied_commitment (id : & ActId , proposal : & ProposalCommitment , recorded_content : & ContentCommitment , host_content_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , content_pair : Option < & ContentPair > ,) -> Result < OpeningComparison , ProfileError >

review.body: { if proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE || recorded_content . recipe != CONTENT_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } if ! valid_id (id) { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } if let Some (pair) = content_pair { check_author (id , & pair . author_content_blinding_value) ? ; } check_host (host_content_blinding_value) ? ; let Some (pair) = content_pair else { return Ok (OpeningComparison :: Unavailable) ; } ; let content = content_pre_digest (id , pair) ? ; let computed = content_from_checked (id , proposal , host_content_blinding_value , SecretValue :: Bytes (content . bytes)) ? ; if computed != * recorded_content { return Err (ProfileError :: Content) ; } Ok (OpeningComparison :: Matches) }
review.item_premise: An optional protected content pair is reduced against a public C_Y; absence and equality are distinct outcomes without authenticating the anchor.
